cards.title: Core Commands
cards.code:
docker build -t my-app:dev .
docker run --rm -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env my-app:dev
docker ps
docker logs -f CONTAINER

cards.title: Basic Dockerfile
cards.code:
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
CMD ["npm", "start"]
cards.description: Pin major versions and use a lockfile.

cards.title: Multi-Stage Build
cards.code:
FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci && npm run build

FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app/.next/standalone ./
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
cards.description: Keep build tools out of the runtime image.

cards.title: Compose
cards.code:
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports: ['3000:3000']
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    volumes: [db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
volumes:
  db-data:

cards.title: .dockerignore
cards.description: Reduce build context and keep secrets out.

cards.title: Health Check
cards.description: Health endpoints should test readiness without expensive work.

cards.title: Run as Non-Root
cards.code:
RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app
USER app
cards.description: Use a minimal image and a non-root runtime user.

cards.title: Image Safety
cards.code:
never bake secrets into ARG/ENV layers
scan images
pin dependencies
rebuild for security patches
set CPU/memory limits
cards.description: Containers isolate processes; they are not a complete security boundary.
